messages:
maria: Heads-up — during the last two postmortems we had repeated delays on remediation signoffs and owners losing context. I want to propose a lightweight 'postmortem follow-up pulse' process: 1) assign owner + deadline in postmortem, 2) weekly pulse check (2-3 bullet update), 3) auto-reminder at 7d/30d, 4) escalation to manager if overdue after 45d. Thoughts? I'm drafting a timeline template.
sam: +1 — saw the same. Can we require an 'owner ack' step where the assigned owner confirms they understand the task and scope within 48h? That saved us a bunch in the last outage.
leo: Agree with both. Also suggest we add a 'blocked-by' and 'risk' column in the tracker so PMs/SREs can triage remediation backlog. Can we integrate with Jira/GH issues? Webhook notifications into slack.
dina: Love the pulse idea. Proposal for comms cadence: weekly digest to #incidents (short summary of active remediations), biweekly deep-dive in ops retro, monthly trend review to spot recurring patterns. Who volunteers to own the weekly digest for the first month?
irene: I can do the first month digest and set up a GitHub issues board with columns ToDo/InProgress/Review/Done. I’ll also add a webhook for new/open/closed status so we get slack pings.
maria: Awesome — thank you. For IC rotation: thought is whoever was IC holds initial accountability for remediations for the first 7 days (context owner), then either hands off to an infra/product owner or keeps it if they have capacity. We should formalize a 15m handoff meeting within 5 days as a policy.
sam: Yes to the 15m handoff meeting. Also recommend adding this line to the postmortem template: "Owner must acknowledge assignment within 48h and schedule a 15m handoff if work extends beyond 7d."
leo: +1. Also we should tag remediations with incident fingerprint so we can easily group recurring patterns (example: "KV-cache-eviction-regression" -> appears in 3 incidents).
maria: Draft timeline template I have in mind:
```
Day 0: incident declared & IC assigned
Day 1 (24-48h): draft postmortem + remediation list; assign owners and deadlines; owners must ACK within 48h
Day 7: pulse update 1 (owner posts 2-3 bullets in channel)
Day 14: pulse update 2 (owner)
Day 30: remediation status + reprioritization based on risk
Day 45: escalation to manager if not closed or materially blocked
```
iro: (typo?)
maria: oops typo — ignore.
dina: For the weekly digest content, suggest: 1) Incident ID + short title, 2) Owner + ETA, 3) Blockers, 4) Risk score (low/medium/high), 5) Link to issue/PR. Keep it to ~8 items max.
irene: I’ll set up the board and add labels for risk and fingerprint. Plan: create board + webhook + sample issue templates by Friday.
maria: Action items we can commit to now: 1) irene -> create GH board + webhook + issue template by Fri COB (owner=irene) 2) sam -> add "owner ack" and 15m handoff step to postmortem template by Tue (owner=sam) 3) leo -> draft weekly digest format and post a sample next Wed (owner=leo) 4) dina -> coordinate biweekly retro slot and monthly trend agenda (owner=dina).
irene: ACK — will do and comment here when board is live.
sam: ACK — will update template and ping templates channel when done.
leo: ACK — will post sample digest in #incidents and tag you all.
oncall-bot: [deploy-bot] Created issue board: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incident-remediations (sample).
maria: Thanks all. Let’s reconvene in this thread after those deliverables and then lock the process. Also scheduling a quick sync in #eng-oncall next Thu 10:00 to review the board + sample digest. :thumbsup:
